title: Rwai Rep Ri Lum (Song of the Mountain Cultivator)
cultural_context: Agrarian chant sung by terrace farmers tilling orange groves, betel plantations, and highland crops.

khasi: Ha ki lum ba phyrnai ngi bet ia u symbai,
U slap u wan slap ban pyndap ka um,
Ka khyndew ka ai ia u soh uba thiang,
Ban pynbiang ka jingbam ia ki khun ki kti.
english: On the radiant hills we sow the seeds,
The showers fall to fill the fresh streams,
The fertile earth yields sweet highland fruits,
Providing wholesome nourishment for our offspring.

vocabulary.bet-symbai: to sow seeds with prayerful hope
